title: CherryJazz
description: This is Cherry Jazz a iris shader wich give you the best performance in Minecraft its made to run smooth in every device even budget devices withouth taking off the beauty of a shader.
body: ![Cherry Jazz preview image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/63910cae764c9bc366f912193b0234f0663eb557.jpeg)Get ready to transform your world! I'm thrilled to share Cherry Jazz, a shader I've poured my heart into for version 1.20.1. It brings the stunning, romantic vibe of Korean cherry blossoms and warm, cozy nights straight into your game. I've optimized it to perform like a dream, so even on older devices, you'll get gorgeous pink skies and smooth FPS without a hint of lag. It's time to make your world beautiful!
